svg.aria-label: Three levels of the food fraud analysis: micro, meso, macro
svg.text: EU official-controls rules (2017/625), RASFF alerts, Codex, international cooperation
Digital systems need coordination, equal access to data and law that keeps pace
Shared data platforms, GS1 traceability, certification bodies, automated quality control
Protected designations of origin, supplier data sharing
IoT sensors, blockchain batch records, QR codes on bottles, DNA and spectroscopic tests
Case: organic extra virgin olive oil adulteration
